Wired mode on this PXN P5 8K Wireless Gaming Controller delivers an 8000Hz polling rate. That speed reports every stick and button movement almost instantly to the system. Competitive shooters and racing titles reward this kind of responsiveness the most. Players notice fewer missed inputs during fast direction changes or rapid combo sequences.

Hall Effect Joysticks and Triggers

Hall-effect sensors use magnetic fields instead of physical contact, which is what prevents drift. This PXN P5 8K Hall Effect Controller stays accurate for months, long after standard sticks start wandering. Hall Linear Triggers add smooth, consistent pull across their entire travel range. That consistency matters most in racing games, where partial trigger presses control acceleration precisely.

Tri-Mode Connectivity Options

This PXN P5 8K Gamepad lets players fine-tune stick sensitivity without touching in-game settings menus. Macro sequences record complex button combinations for one-press execution during matches. RGB presets adjust lighting to match a desk setup or personal preference.

Motion Sensing and Turbo Functions

A 6-axis gyro sensor adds motion-based aiming on top of standard thumbstick input. This PXN P5 8K Gaming Controller uses that sensor for fine aiming corrections sticks alone handle poorly. Turbo functionality automates repeated inputs during intense, fast-paced combat sequences. Macro-programmable buttons extend that further, replaying full action sequences from a single press.

Vibration and RGB Lighting

Asymmetric dual vibration motors deliver distinct feedback depending on the in-game action. This PXN P5 8K Wireless Controller separates impact feedback from ambient rumble more convincingly than single-motor designs. Customizable RGB lighting adds visual identity to any gaming desk setup. Players adjust intensity and pattern through the companion app to match personal taste.

Battery and Charging

A built-in 1000mAh lithium battery powers this PXN wireless gamepad through extended sessions. USB Type-C charging at 5V and 1A keeps recharge times practical between play sessions. Multi-Platform Compatibility

This PXN P5 8K Tri-Mode Wireless Gamepad works across PC, Nintendo Switch, Android, and iOS devices. As a genuine Switch gaming controller, it handles both docked and handheld play equally well. Razer Opus ANC Wireless Headphone comes with THX Certified Headphones and Advanced Active Noise Cancellation (Anc) Technology. This headphone is equipped with advanced active noise cancellation (ANC) technology. Experience pure, high-fidelity sound with zero distractions. The headset presents a rich, balanced soundstage for all your movies, music and gaming.For high-fidelity sound, Tested and optimized by experts in cinematic audio immersion at THX Ltd. In a feedforward setup, active noise cancellation comes from an external microphone that is placed outside the earcup. This microphone is more sensitive to low/mid frequencies and can isolate sounds such as human speech, traffic, and other ambient noises. Unfortunately, due to its sensitive nature, feedforward microphones are notorious. This microphone is more sensitive to low frequencies and hears what the wearer hears. Since a feedback microphone is positioned closer to both your ear and the speaker, there is risk that it may cause high pitched sounds that are painful to hear when not designed correctly. In a hybrid setup, the active noise cancellation comes from both an external and internal microphone, combining the techniques used in feedforward and feedback systems. Due to the advanced nature of hybrid ANC, the technology usually costs twice as much as the others, but in exchange, it provides the best performance. The Razer Opus wireless ANC headset utilizes this hybrid system for active noise cancellation. The Galaxy XR, powered by Android XR, turns productivity, gaming, and entertainment into a seamless, natural, and intuitive experience.

Four Eye-Tracking Cameras

The Galaxy XR's four precision-engineered eye-tracking cameras enable intelligent engagement by recognizing small eye movements and translating them into exact actions. With intuitive hand gesture controls, users can easily explore menus, select items, and modify 3D environments without the need for conventional controllers. The Samsung Galaxy XR's dual-interaction technology improves immersion and accessibility, providing a more natural way to experience mixed reality.

Control with Intuitive Hand Gestures

The powerful beamforming technology separates your voice from surrounding noise. Resulting in accurate responses when you are dictating messages, searching the web, or providing in-app commands.

Up to 2.5 Hours of Battery Life

The Samsung Galaxy XR headset has a battery life of up to 2.5 hours for movie playback and up to 2 hours for general use. It can also be used while charging, allowing for uninterrupted exploration and creativity.

Lightweight and Comfortable

products.name: Sony PlayStation VR2
products.description:
Sony PlayStation VR2

The Sony PlayStation VR2 is a cutting-edge virtual reality headset with outstanding features meant to elevate immersive gaming experiences. The gadget has an OLED display, which provides bright and colorful pictures with crisp contrast and deep blacks. The screen resolution is 2000 x 2040 for each eye, which provides excellent detail and clarity. Depending on the user's preferences, the panel refresh rate may be changed to 90Hz or 120Hz. The headset also has adjustable lens separation, allowing users to find the best suit for their specific needs. The field of vision is roughly 110 degrees, allowing for a broad and immersive viewing experience. The Sony PlayStation VR2 is outfitted with a variety of sensors that provide precise tracking and motion detection. A six-axis motion sensing system, which includes a three-axis gyroscope and a three-axis accelerometer, is included in the gadget. An Infrared proximity sensor and four integrated cameras are also employed to precisely monitor both the headgear and the controller. The Sony PlayStation VR2's eye-tracking capabilities are one of its distinguishing features. The gadget contains an infrared camera for per-eye eye tracking, which may be utilized to improve the VR experience and accuracy, and performance. The Sony PlayStation VR2 provides vibration feedback on the headset to create an even more realistic experience, giving an added element of realism to in-game movements. The gadget connects to the PS5 by USB Type-C and contains a built-in microphone as well as a stereo headphone connector for audio input and output.

4K HDR Display

The Sony PlayStation VR2 features Enjoy breathtaking virtual reality settings in perfect focus with 4K High Dynamic Range images and up to 120fps1, as two 2000 x 2040 OLED screens give nearly four times the resolution generated by the original PlayStation VR headset.

Enhanced Comfort

The Sony PlayStation VR2 has Enjoy relaxing play sessions with a wide 110o field of view and a light, well-balanced Fresnel lens. The lens adjustment dial lets you alter the space between lenses to fit your eye position for the best onscreen display. A vent on the headset provides airflow to the lenses, which decreases fogging and improves player comfort.

Eye Tracking

Engage in new and lifelike ways with the PlayStation VR2 headset, which monitors eye movements and allows for heightened emotional reaction and increased expressiveness when meeting fellow online gamers. Whether shooting or gazing about, eye-tracking cameras follow your line of sight, while innovative foveated rendering algorithms improve the visual experience by altering resolutions to pinpoint and highlight whatever you're concentrating on.

Inside-out Tracking

Play freely as PlayStation VR2 follows you and your controllers via four cameras incorporated into the headgear. Without the need for an external camera, your motions and gaze are mirrored in-game.

Headset Feedback

At important points throughout gaming, feel mild, responsive headset vibrations. These vibrations, which are generated by a single built-in motor, provide an intelligent tactile aspect to the sensory immersion you feel while playing. See your character's raised pulse at anxious moments, the rush of items passing near your head, or the thrust of your car as you accelerate.

Tempest 3D Audio Tech

The Sony PlayStation VR2 Surrounds you with incredibly realistic soundscapes, as in-game audio dynamically adapts to your position and head movements. Since a character’s presence as they whisper in your ear, locate friends and enemies by their gunfire or footfall and experience the creeping dread of a threat approaching from any direction.

Single-cable Connection

Sony PlayStation VR2 With a single-cable connection to the PlayStation 5 console's front USB port, you can jump right into new virtual worlds. The PlayStation VR2 is quick and simple to set up; simply connect in and play.

N.B: PS VR2 is compatible with PlayStation5 consoles
